**How a GPT Is Built and Writes, One Token at a Time**

The plan follows the data through model.py: layer norm, attention, the MLP, the block, the full stack, and then the generation loop and sampling settings in sample.py. I left out training, data preparation and config files, which belong to the other listed topics, and I only read the first 40 lines of each anchor file, so the later sections rest on the topic description until we open the rest of model.py. This is about 20 sittings; the code covers everything you asked for.
